routesToMount.note: Router internally uses /ai/layout-composer/* paths. No additional prefix needed. Final mount path is Team 24's decision.

exempt.reason: Read-only static list; no compute or data mutation

authDependency.note: Auth middleware is applied at the Team 12 router level (not delegated to global adminAuthWithExceptions) so the module is self-contained when Team 24 mounts it.

checks: All constraint elementIds reference existing elements

knownRisks: Routes are pure in-memory compute (no DB) — no migration required to enable the API.
Optional persistence table ai_layout_plans is additive-only (see migration draft) and can be added independently.
No shared event bus usage — fully self-contained.
Response payload can be large for complex layouts with many operations and responsive variants; consumers should paginate or filter fields as needed.
includeResponsive=true triggers up to 4 additional solver runs (one per non-current breakpoint); each is bounded by the same MAX_ITERATIONS and SOLVER_DEADLINE_MS caps.

Content-Length header pre-check (MAX_PAYLOAD_BYTES) can be bypassed by clients that omit the header. Body has already been parsed by app-level express.json(10mb) — pre-check is a defense-in-depth measure, not a hard parse limit.

rotation.description: LayoutElement.rotation is accepted in the request schema. AABB computation is rotation-aware via WP-03B generateAABB — collision boundaries correctly expand for rotated elements. Push-apart resolution vectors are axis-aligned (horizontal/vertical) only; they are not perpendicular to the rotated face. For highly rotated elements, residual overlap along the rotated face may remain after solver convergence.
rotation.workaround: Run a second solve pass if convergence on rotated elements is critical.
